title: Junior Executive on Short Term Basis
qualification: Candidates must hold a Regular / Full Time Degree in Engineering / Technology from Universities / Institutes recognized by appropriate Statutory Authorities in India under the 10+2+4 system (10+3+3 in case of lateral entry to Engineering Courses), in the disciplines / eligible branches listed below. || Note 1: In addition to the above branches, HAL reserves the right to allow candidates with a Degree in any other branches of the same Engineering Disciplines to be considered eligible, provided they meet the other criteria. In such cases, the Degree / provisional Certificate should mention one of the Discipline or Branch mentioned above. || Note 2: As per MHRD O.M. F. No. 11-15/2011-AR(TS.II) dated 06.12.2012, the Technical Courses offered by Professional Bodies / Institutions were de-recognized w.e.f. 01.06.2013. Only candidates who enrolled for these courses up to 31.05.2013 are eligible for consideration as equivalent to a Degree in Engineering. Candidates who enrolled on or after 01.06.2013 are not eligible.
salary: Personnel engaged on Short Term Basis will be inducted in the E0 Pay Scale (2017) of DPE, i.e. Rs. 30,000 – 1,20,000. The basic pay is Rs. 30,000, and an annual increment of 3% on the basic pay is admissible in the second and third year.
age_limit: The upper age limit is not above 28 years as on 17 October 2026 for UR and EWS category candidates. Candidates from OBC-NCL / SC / ST / EWS categories applying for a UR post will be treated on par with UR criteria. Age will be reckoned as on the last date for receipt of applications only. || For SC / ST and OBC-NCL candidates, the caste / tribe name must appear in the Central List notified by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. of India. The certificate must contain the date of issue, and the name must be spelled exactly as in the central list. For EWS candidates, the Income and Asset Certificate must be valid for the financial year 2026-2027 and prepared on the basis of income and asset verification for the financial year 2025-26.
application_fee: The application fee is Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only), inclusive of 18% GST. Candidates belonging to SC / ST / PwBD categories are exempted from the payment of application fee. || An online application form submitted without the requisite fee will be summarily rejected, and no refund will be admissible in such cases. || Once deposited, the application fee will not be refunded under any circumstances, even if the candidate is unable to complete the registration process. || Payment is made online through SBI Collect. The payment page shows the account details as 'HAL CHRC RECRUIMENT 2026-27', as written in the notification. || Payment modes mentioned: credit card / Internet Banking / UPI etc.
selection_process: The selection of candidates will be done through Interview only. There is no written test mentioned in the notification. || Shortlisting:Candidates who fulfil the prescribed eligibility criteria are considered for shortlisting. They are shortlisted on the basis of aggregate marks scored in the qualifying course / examination, in order of merit, in the ratio of 1:10 (maximum) to the number of vacancies in each discipline and category. || Interview:The suitability of shortlisted candidates is assessed by a Selection Committee by way of Interview. The date, time and venue will be intimated to shortlisted candidates only via e-mail, and the list of shortlisted candidates will be hosted on the HAL website. || Final Selection:Selection against the posts notified for each Discipline is made on the basis of performance in the Interview. Candidates must secure at least 50% marks in the Interview to qualify (relaxation for SC / ST / PwBD candidates as per rules). || How shortlisting works: all Unreserved candidates of each discipline, along with SC / ST / OBC-NCL / EWS candidates of that discipline who do not avail any relaxation, are grouped together, arranged in descending order of merit and called in the ratio of 1:10 in the UR category. SC / ST / OBC-NCL / EWS candidates not shortlisted under UR are regrouped with their respective categories and called in the ratio of 1:10 in their respective category. If marks in the qualifying examination are the same, the candidate who is elder or senior in age is considered first. Merely meeting the qualification does not entitle a candidate to be shortlisted for the Interview.

title: Project Associate, Project Engineer and More     – 844 Posts
qualification: For all posts, candidates should have qualified from an AICTE/UGC-approved college/institute or recognized university. || Where a university follows CGPA/DGPA/OGPA or letter grades, the candidate must submit proof of the percentage equivalent and awarded class, along with the degree certificate. || Candidates in their final semester, who will complete the course before appointment, may also apply; if selected, joining is contingent on passing with the required minimum score.
age_limit: The upper age limit is specified against each individual post (see the Pay & Age Grades table above for typical ranges). || SC/ST/OBC, physically challenged (PwBD), and Ex-Servicemen candidates are eligible for age relaxation as per Government of India norms. || Government employees on a pay scale get a 5-year age relaxation, in addition to other applicable relaxations. || The cut-off date for age and experience is the last date of application submission for the respective centre. || SSLC/SSC/ISC mark sheet/certificate, or any other valid document, is accepted as proof of date of birth. || The EWS certificate must strictly follow the DoPT-prescribed format (available at www.persmin.nic.in); the OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate must also be in the prescribed format.
selection_process: Initial screening based on academic records and other parameters declared in the online application; only screened-in candidates proceed further. || C-DAC may raise the minimum eligibility criteria/cut-offs at its discretion if the number of applicants is high for any post. || Candidates are evaluated on academic credentials, experience profile, written test marks (if applicable), and interview performance. || The selection process is carried out independently by each C-DAC centre, based on its own requirements; only shortlisted candidates are contacted. || All submitted information is verified against original documents at document verification or any later stage; false or non-conforming information leads to rejection/cancellation at any stage.

title: Scientist Engineer 'SC'
qualification: Aggregate minimum of 65% marks (average of all semesters) or CGPA 6.84 on a 10 point scale. AMIE / Grade IETE candidates should have a minimum of 65% marks or CGPA 6.84 on a 10 point scale in Section B alone.
salary: Scientist Engineer 'SC' is placed at Level 10 of the Pay Matrix, with a pay range of ₹56,100 to ₹1,77,500. || The notification does not give the in-hand salary or allowance details. It states that, as per Central Government orders, ISRO employees also receive benefits such as medical facilities for self and dependents, a subsidised canteen, House Building Advance, Leave Travel Concession, the National Pension System/Unified Pension Scheme and other social security measures. Career advancement for scientific and technical personnel in ISRO is based on the Merit Promotion Scheme, under which employees are reviewed and promoted to the next grade on merit after a prescribed residency period, without reference to vacancies.
age_limit: The maximum age limit for all three posts is 30 years as on 13.10.2026. || Ex-servicemen, Persons With Benchmark Disabilities and Departmental candidates are eligible for age relaxation as per the Government of India orders issued on the subject from time to time. The notification does not specify the number of years of relaxation. || To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.
application_fee: Initially, all applicants have to pay a uniform application fee of ₹750 (Rupees Seven Hundred and Fifty only). A refund is then made according to the category of the candidate.
selection_process: The selection process for all posts consists of a Written Test followed by a Personal Interview.
